html:
Here is the galaxy Messier 33, also called Triangulum because it is located in the constellation Triangulum. It is located 3 million light-years from earth. It is part of the Local Group of galaxies, along with the Milky Way, the Andromeda Galaxy and about thirty other galaxies of lesser importance.



The technical details
Date:  2011/10/25
Optical train = AT8RC @ F8 - astrodon LRGB gen2 filters - QSI583wsg @ -15c
Mount: Takahashi EM-200 Temma II driven with the TheSky6 software and guided with phd, QHY5 on the QSI
Acquisition with Nebulosity
Site: At home
L:RG:B 10X(600:600:600:600)
Bias, dark and flats applied
Pre-processing and processing in PixInsight
